_README: Fixture registry. Identical to clean-declared-probe-deferral in every field EXCEPT
`expires`, which is in the past. An EXPIRED declaration is not a declaration: the
scanner stops honouring it and the named probe path reds as dangling-probes-binding,
which is what makes the date load-bearing rather than decorative. The date is fixed
in the past so this case cannot flip green with the calendar.

.claude/test-harness/probes/deferredprob.reason: Fixture stand-in for a probe-authorship deferral whose promised date has come and gone with no suite written.
.claude/test-harness/probes/deferredprob.graduation: Delete this entry in the same change that lands the suite and registers it in eval-manifest.json.
